content: One clearly parametrized assembly: five lightweight HUB75 modules, 12 mm sidewalls/bottom/roof, 9 mm attached rear, 4 mm glass and four straight-mitred wooden retainers from one GlassStrip class. The roof extends 10 mm in front and 1 mm beyond the attached rear sheet. Eight printed corner brackets, two per corner, share the hole-free CornerBracket definition. The four rear brackets stop at the sidewall rear face (Y=75), before the 9 mm backboard (Y=75..84). The R4 fillets belong to the roof and bottom boards, not the glazing strips.
